name: FZ Consent Banner and Logs
author: Niko

sections.description:
Want to protect your website from fines and earn your visitors’ trust? This lightweight plugin is your reliable assistant for compliance with GDPR and 152-FZ personal data laws.

What’s Inside:

Smart consent banner – with clear “Accept”/“Reject” buttons and detailed settings for every cookie type (necessary, analytical, and marketing cookies). Visitors will appreciate the transparency, and you’ll enjoy peace of mind.

Consent logging for all key forms: comments, wpDiscuz, WooCommerce, WPForms, and Contact Form 7. No extra steps required – lawful consent is collected automatically wherever it is needed.

Full audit trail with CSV export – every user action is recorded, and you can export a report for regulators in a single click. Forget about bureaucratic headaches.

Convenient admin panel with page‑by‑page log navigation – easily locate any record, even when there are thousands of consents. Everything is structured, clear, and right at your fingertips.

Integration with analytics services (Yandex.Metrica, Google Analytics) that load only after consent is obtained. No data leaks, no risks – only clean statistics from people who truly gave their permission.

Install the plugin right now – and your website will become not only fully compliant, but genuinely customer‑focused =^-^=)

External Services

This plugin optionally loads analytics counters based on user consent. These are third-party services:

Google Analytics (gtag.js)

The plugin can load Google Analytics tracking script from googletagmanager.com when the user provides consent for analytics cookies. This is used to track website visits and user interactions.
– Service provider: Google LLC
– Data sent: Page views, user interactions, anonymized IP address (depending on configuration)
– Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Analytics (analytics.js)

For legacy Universal Analytics tracking IDs (UA-XXXXXXXX-X), the plugin loads analytics.js from google-analytics.com.
– Service provider: Google LLC
– Data sent: Page views, user interactions
– Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Yandex.Metrika

The plugin can load Yandex.Metrika counter script from mc.yandex.ru when the user provides consent for analytics cookies. This is used to track website visits and user behavior.
– Service provider: Yandex LLC
– Data sent: Page views, clicks, user behavior data
– Terms of Service: https://yandex.com/legal/metrica_termsofuse/
– Privacy Policy: https://yandex.com/legal/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “Settings -> FZ Consent Banner and Logs” to configure
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

There were errors in the code that kept the cookie banner from functioning properly.

1.1.2

Fixed a bug where the cookie banner didn’t respond to user actions.

1.1.1

  • All prefixes in the plugin have been renamed to avoid conflicts with other plugins.
  • Instead of text, a donation link is now present.

1.1.0

  • Added WPForms and Contact Form 7 support
  • Built-in wpDiscuz compatibility
  • Added cookie categories (Necessary, Analytics, Marketing)
  • Added analytics counters support (Yandex.Metrika, Google Analytics)

1.0.0

  • Initial release
